summary: Three hand-picked galleries — components, dark mode, motion — and why curation is becoming a product of its own.

note.en: open-source UI elements, community-made, copy the HTML/CSS and go. Design systems keep getting heavier; this one ships a single element instead.
note.zh: 开源 UI 元素库，社区贡献，复制 HTML/CSS 就走。妙在粒度：不是整套设计系统，是能单拎一个按钮、不带着全家桶偷走。

note.en: hand-picked dark websites, one vertical, no noise. Dark mode has moved from a feature toggle to an aesthetic worth its own site.
note.zh: 人工精选的暗色网站，只做这一个垂直，没有噪音。暗色模式早就离开"功能"的范畴，给自己盖了个博物馆。

note.en: interaction details from well-built iOS and web apps, filtered by frame rate. The name is the filter: nothing below 60fps.
note.zh: 从最好的 iOS 和网页应用里收来的交互细节。名字本身就是立场：低于 60 不是动效，是卡顿。
